title: 第19章 破城级强者求追读第20章 初掌东宫
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
夜色深沉，钦点的龟兹舞女、狐族绝色、小宗圣女……都已经睡下，在特殊香料的作用下，她们没有几个时辰很难醒来。
夏无恙这才扒开身上的雪臂玉足，悄然进入练功室，将玄铁大门牢牢地反锁起来。
心灵力场无声无息展开，将周围几十米尽数笼罩其中，但凡发现异常之处，就能够及时作出应对。
接着取出那瓶天水精华，准备借助奇宝，再次大幅度提升修为境界。
正常情况下他需要再等一段时间，才能够服用第二瓶天水精华，毕竟上一瓶服用没多久，修为境界刚刚大幅度提升过。
若是服用太多太勤的话，很容易导致根基不稳，从而影响后续的修行。
不过龙虎拳法已经被他改良成功，乃是为他量身打造，再加上夏无恙悟性惊人，很快就巩固完成，就算现在服用也没有太大的问题。
盘膝而坐，面前摆放着晶莹剔透的玉瓶，瓶中盛放着湛蓝色的天水精华，在烛火的映照下，仿佛有星河在其中流淌。
不再犹豫，抬手打开瓶塞，将里面的天水精华一饮而尽。
刹那间，一股磅礴而又温和的药力涌入他的体内，夏无恙浑身颤动，皮肤表面浮现出无数细密的蓝色纹路，仿佛有水流在他的体内奔涌。
顾不得多想，连忙运转龙虎拳法，开始吸收天水精华。
气血之力迅速增长，很快就来到了瓶颈桎梏，这是通往五品之境的瓶颈桎梏。
但是在天水精华和龙虎气血的双重作用下，突破起来难度并不大。
超高的精神力量也能够让夏无恙如臂指使地控制每一分力量，对瓶颈堤坝发起冲击，造成最大的战果，至少让他冲关的成功率提升了几成以上。
再加上量身打造的龙虎拳法，冲关和修行的时候都有着事半功倍的效果，所以这道关卡很快就开始晃动起来。
“咔嚓……”
一声脆响，夏无恙的全身筋络猛然震颤，通往更高层次的瓶颈堤坝也倒塌下来。
他的气息开始节节攀升，龙虎气血汹涌增长，练功室中的空气都因为暴增的气血之力，变得燥热起来。
顾不得多想，夏无恙立即调动庞大的龙虎气血，朝着全身的骨骼淬炼和渗透过去，不断地提升这些骨骼。
五品之境！

炼骨境！
这一境界被称之为破城境，意思不言而喻，能够轻松地破城毁房，有着万夫不当之勇。
普通的城池在他们面前，就像是玩具一样孱弱，即使是一些巨城，稍有不慎也会被其生生地攻破。
一旦踏入此境，便有了统领一支军队的资格。
不过五品初期并非天水精华的极限，剩余的天水精华还有不少，继续提升着他的修为境界。
五品初期……骨骼增强，力量剧增！
五品中期……骨骼强韧，洞穿惊人！
一直到接近五品后期的时候，天水精华的药力才被消化殆尽，夏无恙的实力比起之前，何止提升了三倍。
全身的骨骼变得坚韧无比，每一根都蕴含着惊人的力量，汇聚在一起，能够爆发出可怕的杀伤力，轻而易举地洞穿敌人的要害所在。
content_en:
The night was dark, and the specially appointed dancers from Qiuci, the beauty of the fox clan, and the saint from the Xiaozong... had all fallen asleep. Under the influence of the special spices, it was difficult for them to wake up for a few hours.
Xia Wuyang then took off his snowy arms and jade feet, quietly entered the practice room, and locked the black iron door tightly.
The psychic force field unfolds silently, covering tens of meters around it. Whenever an abnormality is discovered, it can be responded to in time.
Then he took out the bottle of Tianshui essence and prepared to use Qibao to greatly improve his cultivation level again.
Under normal circumstances, he would need to wait for a while before taking the second bottle of Tianshui Essence. After all, he had taken the last bottle not long ago and his cultivation level had just been greatly improved.
If you take too much and too frequently, it will easily lead to an unstable foundation, which will affect your subsequent practice.
However, the Dragon Tiger Boxing Technique has been successfully improved by him, and it was tailor-made for him. In addition, Xia Wuhuang has an amazing understanding, and it was quickly consolidated and completed. Even if he takes it now, there is no big problem.
Sitting cross-legged, there is a crystal clear jade bottle in front of him. The bottle contains the essence of azure sky water. Under the light of the candle, it seems that there are stars flowing in it.
Without hesitation, he raised his hand to open the cork and drank the essence of Tianshui inside.
In an instant, a majestic yet gentle medicinal power poured into his body. Xia Wuyan's whole body trembled, and countless fine blue lines appeared on the surface of his skin, as if water was rushing through his body.
Without thinking too much, he quickly used the Dragon Tiger Boxing Technique and began to absorb the essence of Tianshui.
The power of Qi and blood increased rapidly, and soon reached the bottleneck, which was the bottleneck leading to the fifth level.
However, under the dual effects of Tianshui Essence and Dragon and Tiger Qi and Blood, it is not difficult to break through.
The ultra-high mental strength also allowed Xia Wuyou to control every ounce of power like an arm, launching an impact on the bottleneck and dam, resulting in the greatest results, at least increasing his success rate by more than a few percent.
Coupled with the tailor-made Dragon and Tiger Boxing Technique, it has the effect of getting twice the result with half the effort when passing the level and practicing, so this level soon started to shake.
"Click..."
With a crisp sound, Xia Wuyan's whole body trembled suddenly, and the bottleneck dam leading to a higher level collapsed.
His aura began to rise steadily, the dragon and tiger qi and blood surged, and the air in the practice room became hot due to the surge of qi and blood.
Without thinking too much, Xia Wuchang immediately mobilized the huge dragon and tiger energy and blood to temper and penetrate into the bones of his body, constantly improving these bones.
The realm of fifth grade!
Bone refining realm!
This state is called the city-breaking state, and the meaning is self-evident. It can easily destroy the city and destroy the houses, and it has the courage to be worthy of ten thousand people.
Ordinary cities are as weak as toys in front of them. Even some giant cities will be destroyed by them if they are not careful.
Once you step into this realm, you will be qualified to command an army.
However, the early stage of fifth grade is not the limit of Tianshui essence. There is still a lot of Tianshui essence left, which continues to improve his cultivation level.
At the early stage of the fifth grade...the bones are strengthened and the strength is greatly increased!
Middle stage of fifth grade...the bones are strong and the penetration is amazing!
It was not until the late stage of the fifth grade that the medicinal power of the Tianshui Essence was completely digested, and Xia Wuyan's strength was more than three times higher than before.
The bones in the whole body have become extremely tough, and each one contains amazing power. When gathered together, they can burst out with terrifying lethality, easily penetrating the enemy's vital points.
